summary: Max Verstappen won the Australian Grand Prix from pole position, 0.2s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Fernando Alonso completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P20 to P5.
Carlos Sainz had a day to forget, dropping from P5 to P12.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag, 3 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised SAI (5 second time penalty).
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 15 points over Sergio Perez.
